correctness.rationale: The paperfolding odd-part normalization yields p_(2n)=p_n, p_(4n+1)=0 and p_(4n+3)=1, hence the exact block 001(t mod2)011p_(t+1). All 8 incoming-flag/parity/end-symbol cases give a completed-arch increment 3+q-z and outgoing flag z, so telescoping yields U(8T)=3T-p_T. All eight partial-block cases supply the displayed r=0..7 formula. Binary greedy arches characterize universality for all targets; the density of p_T=1 is 1/2 by parity recursion, giving sharp E in [-8,1] and the ten-point limit law. An independent 300000-prefix greedy computation matched the formula; it is corroboration, not the infinite proof.
